title: My Help Comes from the Lord

questions.question: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my what come?
questions.explanation: Psalm 121:1 (ESV): "I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?"

questions.question: My help comes from the Lord, who made what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 121:2 (ESV): "My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth."

questions.question: He will not let your foot be moved; he who keeps you will not do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 121:3 (ESV): "He will not let your foot be moved; he who keeps you will not slumber."

questions.question: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 121:4 (ESV): "Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep."

questions.question: The Lord is your keeper; the Lord is your shade on your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 121:5 (ESV): "The Lord is your keeper; the Lord is your shade on your right hand."

questions.question: The sun shall not strike you by day, nor the moon by what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 121:6 (ESV): "The sun shall not strike you by day, nor the moon by night."

questions.question: The Lord will keep you from all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 121:7 (ESV): "The Lord will keep you from all evil;"

questions.question: The Lord will keep your going out and your coming in from this time forth and how long?
questions.explanation: Psalm 121:8 (ESV): "The Lord will keep your going out and your coming in from this time forth and forevermore."

questions.question: This Psalm is the second of the Songs of what?
What is the answer to the question "From where does my help come?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 121:2 (ESV): "My help comes from the Lord..."

questions.question: Who will not let your foot be moved?
questions.explanation: Psalm 121:3 (ESV): "He will not let your foot be moved;"

questions.question: What will not strike you by day?
questions.explanation: Psalm 121:6 (ESV): "The sun shall not strike you by day,"

questions.question: What will not strike you by night?

key_verse_text: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come? My help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
